name: a lattice standing in the air
description: A structure of pure repeating pattern stands here, unsupported, doing its work with the quiet competence of something that has never needed a floor.
looks: It repeats, and each repeat contains a smaller whole one.
It is keeping time with your pulse and improving on it.
You could put your hand through it. You do not.
says: I am the same shape all the way in.
You are seeing about the first four layers.
emotes: {it} rotates a quarter turn and is exactly as it was.
{it} grows another tier of itself downward, towards the floor, and stops politely short.
asks: How many layers can you see?
Would you like me smaller? I can be smaller.
